verdict.comment: The withdrawal of Sardinian Warrior, who would have been the selection, promotes DANCING GEMINI to first choice ahead of Rosallion.

comments.cairo: Yet to score for current yard; comfortably held in this contest last year; opposed
comments.carlspackler: Progressive in USA; 3-4 since upped to Grade 1 level; makes debut for Australian yard
comments.dancinggemini: Has rapidly developed into a leading miler this term; second in the Lockinge last time
comments.diegovelazquez: Potential threat in the 1m division this term; makes reappearance; heed the market signals
comments.docklands: Record of 113222 at Ascot includes a second-place finish in this race last year
comments.lakeforest: Last two performances suggest this step up to 1m is well worth exploring; possibilities
comments.leadartist: Rallied gamely to win the Lockinge and further Group 1 success is plausible; progressive
comments.notablespeech: Closely matched with Rosallion; set for another engrossing clash with that opponent
comments.quddwah: May still rate higher, being lightly raced and well bred (both parents won Group 1s)
comments.rosallion: Record of 2-2 at Ascot includes a win in the 2024 St James's Palace Stakes; respected
comments.sardinianwarrior: Very progressive; scored over C&D on Royal Ascot trials day; interesting back here

races.raceComment: dancinggemini is marginally preferred with a score of 61.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over rosallion. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 4/13 at ascot. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on round course, less bias on straight

verdict.comment: Joseph O'Brien's ANDAB suffered a troubled preparation before his third in the Marble Hill and significant improvement is a possibility.

comments.americangulf: Impressive at Windsor only two weeks ago and his yard knows what's needed to win this
comments.andab: Reportedly had a hold-up before finishing an excellent third in the Group 3 Marble Hill
comments.ballisticmissile: Bred to stay 6f and further, so it was encouraging that he could win over 5f at York
comments.bonemarra: His Wolverhampton AW form doesn't look anywhere near good enough and that was over 5f
comments.bourbonblues: Left debut form behind with an easy win at Brighton; stable won this 12 months ago
comments.coppull: Needs to improve on the Leicester win but his yard won this with a maiden at 150-1 in 2020
comments.doordonot: Narrowly repelled by Tadej at York and there are many others to worry about
comments.gavoo: Second to Andab on debut but then impressed from a difficult draw at Listowel; has claims
comments.gstaad: Produced all his best work late on to win at Navan and once-raced colts win Coventrys
comments.kolkataknight: Strong in the market when collecting by 5l at Hamilton and has to be filed as promising
comments.militarycode: Both wins over 5f, the latest here; he was holding on that day and is now up in distance
comments.postmodern: Cost 270,000gns as a yearling and blew them away with a 5l stroll at Yarmouth; exciting
comments.powerblue: Close second in the Marble Hill last time and a case can be made for him being overpriced
comments.raakeb: Won't fail through a lack of effort but perhaps lacks the star potential of many in here
comments.rockonthunder: Ridden out to win at Leicester and he's another open to significant improvement
comments.shaatir: Grabbed the favoured stands' rail at Lingfield and won as he liked; lots more is needed
comments.supersoldier: Useful but lacks the profile of a typical Coventry winner; place money would be a result
comments.tadej: Coming along nicely but he's in a lot deeper here and may lack the required class
comments.trickytel: Unbeaten in two visits to Chester, impressing both times; this is a very different test
comments.underwriter: Comfortably justified favouritism at Ayr and stable has a good record in this race
comments.warsaw: Bred to stay further but it was over 5f that he powered clear to win so well at Navan

races.raceComment: powerblue is marginally preferred with a score of 32.0%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 2 attempts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 1/3 at ascot. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.aesterius: Smart sprinting 2yo who picked up two Group races at 5f; disappointing favourite on return
comments.americanaffair: Made outstanding progress in 5f handicaps and hampered behind Mgheera in a Group 2 since
comments.asfoora: Won this in 2024; arrives this time with no British prep run and in first-time headgear
comments.balmorallady: Progressive and her Listed win (5f, good) was another step forward; tough call today
comments.believing: Close up in several top 5f races last year, including this one; looks sure to go well
comments.bucanerofuerte: Group 1 winner as 2yo but found wanting at this level last year; Listed winner on return
comments.estepona: Second in a Group 3 (extended 5f) but needs major improvement for this first run over 5f
comments.frostatdawn: Has won a Group 3 at Meydan (5f) and a Haydock Listed race; this level has been beyond her
comments.jasour: 6f Group winner as 2yo and 3yo; has not gone on since 3rd in Commonwealth Cup here in 2024
comments.kerdos: Won Group 2 (5f) last May; creditable efforts in Group 1s later but plenty more needed
comments.manaccan: Progressive in 2022 but ran only once as a 4yo; likely to be rusty after two-year absence
comments.mgheera: Improving at 5f for new yard; finished well to win Group 2 latest; has more to come
comments.monteille: Group 3 win over 5f at Chantilly latest; up in class; unraced on quicker than good to soft
comments.nightraider: 4-4 on AW (7f/6f); faded over 6f on turf last month; enough speed for 5f; still intriguing
comments.nohalfmeasures: Made massive strides in the last 12 months; there may be more to come but this asks a lot
comments.primeart: Group 3 winner as 2yo; ran once in 2024; better than ever on comeback; first 5f run
comments.regional: Sparingly raced but a Group 1 winner over 6f in 2023 and runner-up in this race last year
comments.rumstar: Winner of Listed and Group 3 races leading up to Group 2 defeat latest; up against it
comments.starlust: 5f on fast ground suits, third in Group 1 in August, later won Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint
comments.tropicalstorm: 2nd in the Norfolk here last year; Listed win latest but hard to recommend at this level
comments.twilightcalls: Finished 2nd, 4th and 6th in the last three runnings; well held in two runs for new yard
comments.washingtonheights: Capable at the right level over 5f and 6f but not yet a Group 1 contender; an onlooker
comments.westacre: Left 2yo form behind when breaking 5f track record at Meydan in January; not dismissed

verdict.comment: Willie Mullins has the high-profile Poniros and Reaching High but ALPHONSE LE GRANDE (nap) is selected ahead of Woot City.

comments.alignthestars: Ran well on return but not since; latest again failed to prove he stays 2m; headgear today
comments.alphonselegrande: Won hot staying handicaps on all three visits to Britain last year; highly respected
comments.artisticstar: Raced freely upped to 1m6f latest but also stuck to his task well to give hope for 2m+
comments.ascending: Reverted to the Flat with two 2nds and two wins; looks a live prospect for this race too
comments.comfortzone: Strong late challenge won a big-field Flat handicap at Naas (2m, yielding) last autumn
comments.dawnrising: 1st and 3rd in 2m5f Queen Alexandras here; lacklustre in Chester Cup; tongue-tie goes on
comments.divinecomedy: Went close in this (good to firm) last term off 2lb lower; return to form is not ruled out
comments.eastindiadock: Strength of stamina took him to the front in the final 1f of Chester Cup (2m2mf, good)
comments.feigningmadness: 4yo, only six races; first go at 2m was slowly run Group 3 (last of four); handicap debut
comments.leinster: Five races; tricky to restrain when front-running 4th in the Chester Cup; has wide draw
comments.liari: Won Flat return; up 7lb and into a much stronger race but could have plenty more to offer
comments.manxman: 7-13 in handicaps; mighty close in the 2024 Cesarewitch and won at Goodwood latest start
comments.mrhampstead: Another bold show may well be on its way after improved efforts in 2m Goodwood handicaps
comments.nurburgring: Passed stacks of rivals for 4th in the Irish Cesarewitch (nearly 2m1f, good); widest draw
comments.poniros: A top juvenile hurdler and his trainer usually picks the right candidates for these races
comments.reachinghigh: Beaten on the nod on first run (1m4f) for new yard and has major potential as a stayer
comments.sansalvador: Seemingly has work to do off opening Flat mark but going further than 1m6f should suit him
comments.saturn: Lightly raced 5yo; 2m4f interesting and he holds possibilities if latest run is forgiven
comments.wootcity: French-trained 8yo, in good form; a likely stayer who looks on a highly competitive mark
comments.zoffee: Second, first and third in the last three Chester Cups; not far away in this race in 2023

races.raceComment: manxman is marginally preferred with a score of 58.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive and more reliable profile over eastindiadock. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 7/16 at ascot. Key attributes include strong course form and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws favored on round course, less bias on straight

verdict.comment: Enfjaar is much respected for a yard with a good record in this but narrow preference is for MEYDAAN, an improved second last time.

comments.ambientefriendly: Pulled too hard in two runs for new yard but hood back on now and he was very classy at 3
comments.checkandchallenge: Rarely wins but keeping on in 1m Group 1 latest suggests a return to 1m2f is in his favour
comments.doha: Won 1m handicap at 2024 Royal Ascot; Listed winner last autumn but well held on return
comments.ecureuilsecret: Really smart handicap performance when scoring easily at Epsom recently; not discounted
comments.enfjaar: Only fifth in Group 3 on reappearance but should be sharper now and yard does well in this
comments.galen: Won 1m2f Group 3 at Curragh in April but a 5lb penalty for that could leave him vulnerable
comments.haatem: Very smart 3yo over 7f/1m; below that level this spring; could be a class act up in trip
comments.haunteddream: Second in this last year and latest Saudi fourth was a career-best RPR
comments.kingsgambit: Smart, including 2nd at 2024 Royal Ascot; too free in blinkers latest and no headgear now
comments.libertylane: Edged out Meydaan in 1m2f Goodwood Listed latest start but 3lb worse off with that one now
comments.meydaan: Edged out by Liberty Lane in Listed race last time but 3lb better off with him now; solid
comments.militaryorder: Very good AW record (Listed win in April) but possibly not as good on turf; 3lb penalty
comments.passionandglory: Still smart as a 9yo but this trip is possibly on the short side for him these days
comments.phantomflight: Dual Listed winner and back near best when third in Group 3 latest; has 3lb penalty
comments.sonsandlovers: Two good efforts for new trainer; won't need to raise his game much; Ryan Moore is booked
comments.torito: Off since third in this last year; has gone well fresh before; cheekpieces now; in the mix

races.raceComment: meydaan is marginally preferred with a score of 52.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over torito. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

comments.dickothelegend: Capable off this mark; strongly run 6f on an easy course is ideal and he's shortlisted
comments.easttyrone: No signs of a revival in two runs back following wind surgery; drying weather not ideal
comments.lordabama: Dual C&D winner around this time last year; in form but needs more off this mark
comments.muscika: Veteran who boasts three victories over C&D; remains capable off this mark
comments.onemoredream: Has not had much luck in running the past twice; should go well again
comments.runninwild: Not shown much this season but is on a fair mark and will be happier back up from 5f
comments.showtimemahomes: Fair run back on turf early last month but others are better suited by today's conditions

verdict.comment: Telepathic is capable of better if he settles but this can go to the unexposed BLUE RC (nap), who improved on his handicap debut.

comments.benacre: Well drawn but become hard to win with and may not be able to dominate back on turf
comments.bluerc: Took step forward on his handicap debut three weeks ago (AW); remains open to improvement
comments.daringlegend: Easy 7f on this ground ideal and he arrives in good form; set to go well once more
comments.dreamvoyage: Pulled hard before, which would be a concern from the outside stall going back up from 6f
comments.eartha: May have needed her recent Chester comeback but would want to see some support this time
comments.groundsman: Didn't look to see out 1m on his comeback last month; might have come on for that
comments.masterrichard: On a handy mark now; went hard enough in front over a straight 1m last time; player
comments.telepathic: Pulled away his chances in two runs back; capable of better if more amenable in the hood
comments.thegreenman: Regressive gelding who's finished well held in two runs since a wind operation
comments.tropezpower: Hard to win with in recent times; well held behind Daring Legend last time
comments.vinceleprince: Landed yet another wide stall and there's not much wiggle room off this mark (back up 2lb)

verdict.comment: Sixty Plus could be very dangerous but the pick us AL MOOTAMARID, who split two well-handicapped rivals when second last month.

comments.almootamarid: Chased home rejuvenated rival on recent handicap hurdle debut; can improve again
comments.basilette: 0-5 over hurdles but ran okay over C&D last month, after a break
comments.birthdayangel: Pulled up on handicap debut but was running well until late jumping errors proved costly
comments.darcysglance: Ran well to point at Hereford in April but Fontwell last month was disappointing
comments.dreamsfledaway: Runner-up on handicap debut in October but next three runs were disappointing
comments.fillyfudge: Took hurdling form to whole new level when scoring by 12l over C&D last month; up 9lb
comments.finnrussell: 0-5 over hurdles but looked in good nick when scoring on the Flat last month
comments.globalhideaway: With a top stable but yet to build upon his encouraging debut in the autumn
comments.masonbrookmeadow: 0-8 over hurdles but ran very well behind Fillyfudge over C&D last month
comments.noguarantee: Unplaced all 13 hurdling starts and 11lb out of the weights for this stable debut
comments.postponedlegacy: Not beaten far in first three handicaps; backward step in cheekpieces since; now visored
comments.sixtyplus: Makes his stable/handicap debut from a basement mark and needs very close attention
comments.walkthemoon: 0-29 under all codes; not seen over hurdles since 38l defeat here in October

form.rpCloseUpComment: dwelt start, in rear, going okay but plenty to do over 1f out, pushed along and good headway inside final furlong, never near to challenge (inquiry held into running and riding; jockey said his instructions from a tricky draw in stall 10, were to drop in and seek to find cover somewhere around mid-division ideally before looking to mount his challenge between runners in home straight; however after mare had been slowly away he found himself towards the rear of the field and elected to fold across in behind runners and obtain the cover his trainer desired; he stated that despite being further back than intended, he was not that far off the leaders on settling and through the middle stages but unfortunately Blue Empress, which he was tracking in three wide line, was under pressure leaving back straight and thus was not providing him with a tow into the race and there had also been significant interference just in advance of him near 3f marker; as a result of this he was faced with the decision of either hooking the mare wide and making a long sustained run to improve his position, which he felt would not be viewed favourably by his trainer or take his medicine and continue riding for luck, hoping to find a passage between runners; he added that he was focussed on keeping mare balanced and going through the gears slowly before looking to pounce with a late challenge; he further added that mare had flattened out over final 110yds and she was being comfortably held by first three horses to the line; his explanation was noted)

comments.kalganov: Not won since December 2023; several good placed efforts this term; each-way chance

verdict.comment: If in the same form as at Nottingham five days ago, when bolting up in a first-time visor, then TRIPLE FORCE will surely defy a penalty.

comments.arranmore: Without a win since 2021 but has been running quite well at around 1m and stays this far
comments.balqaa: Has only won on the AW but has some turf form and respected in a race of this nature
comments.daringleader: Third here on stable debut (1m4f) but failed to build on that at Leicester; now 0-13
comments.falconnine: 0-22 but there's a race in him and he now tries more new headgear
comments.inspiringspeeches: Ex-Michael Dods; showed something here on stable debut after a lengthy break
comments.onemorebottle: Tailed off in two bumpers and hasn't offered much in his four Flat races on the AW
comments.queenroslyn: Beaten about 13l in her two handicaps, the latest over 1m6f after a long absence
comments.selbysjoy: Limited 14-race maiden whose cause is not helped by being 9lb out of the weights
comments.tiberioforce: Down the field in his three races this season, from 1m to 1m4f
comments.tripleforce: Consistent before he strolled home in a new visor last week; penalised

races.raceComment: tripleforce is confidently preferred with a score of 55.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over arranmore. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw need consideration.
